session_findings.claim: Browser JavaScript prefixes paths with body[data-subsite]; Canning empty subsite.
POST form csrf token copied from body[data-csrf] only if present; absent in captured guest pages.
Active saved-list cookie name uses P + GetCookie(NAME), with BRWSESSION fallback. This does not establish auth cookie name.
Search results carry opaque setId in subsequent links. Lifetime and cookie binding have not been measured.
Same-origin AJAX has no explicitly assigned Authorization header in inspected scripts; browser cookie/session behavior inferred, not verified.
Authorised SPYDUS_BRWSESSIONID_443 cookie accepted for authenticated OPAC account/loan/reservation GETs; only cookie name retained publicly.
Authenticated HTML body carries data-csrf and data-displaycontext. Token values omitted.

gaps: Final renewal/cancellation/edit request responses, confirmations, eligibility and mutation success/errors remain unmeasured; routes are static references only.
Reservation creation pickup-location/eligibility/confirmation flow remains unverified.
Browser account detail/loan/reservation HTML read contracts verified; authenticated charges, history and notification-read semantics not captured.
Native JSON account/loan/reservation models and login transport belong in mobile contract/capture inventory.
API permissions, server rate limits, setID expiry and CSRF enforcement not measured.

authenticated_capture.route_variant_observation: WQUP account entry returned meta redirect; supplied ENQ/WQUP/BRWENQ returned 400. Replacing WQUP with OPAC returned authenticated 200. OPAC account entry and its returned OPAC redirect also succeeded.
